correctness.rationale: For all finite k≥2, using p_n=e^{kλ}Pr(X=n), the exact block formula p_{k+2+t}−p_{k+1+t}=λ²(S_{k+t}−T_t) for 0≤t≤k−2 follows from Q(z)=exp(λz/(1−z)) and P=Q exp(−λ z^{k+1}/(1−z)). Vandermonde expansion and (i+j+2)!≥(i+1)!(j+2)! prove S_{k+t}≤S_k T_t. For k≥3 the first edge has λ*<1; k=2 separately follows from λ*=2(√7−2) and λ*S_1(λ*)<1. The positive-coefficient recurrence n p_n=λΣj p_{n−j} extends a k+1-long initial decreasing block to every n≥k. At the threshold p_{k+2}=p_{k+1}, above it reversal, proving necessity. Independently reproduced 44 exact Fraction initial coefficient identities for k=2..9; this is supporting finite evidence, not the infinite proof.
